entry: Hovering an automated plot now says how many days until its next review.
Farm plots now look slightly different by topic type without relying on colour: grammar plots have a dashed border, phrases a dotted one, and phonetic plots a double border.
A plot in the weeds now names the look-alike it is easy to mix up with, in its hover text.
Gender-tagging questions now show your running gender-drill accuracy under the question.
After you rate your confidence (Sure / Not sure) on a few questions, a small line shows how often each rating was actually right this session.
Liaison practice now shows a small sound legend (for example [z] = the 'z' in 'zoo') when a question mentions a bracketed sound.
A small bar at the top of the farm now shows how much of the whole farm is automated.

First-run look picker: the first time you open the game on a desktop you can choose High-def, Low-poly, Text-based or Cartoon (or skip for High-def), and change it later in Settings. They are restyles of the same game, not separate artwork.

Practice now counts: the four arcade minigames, the gender drill, liaison practice, proficiency tests and bonus sentences all feed a new Practice score at the top of the farm, with per-mode accuracy on the progress dashboard (capped per day so it can't be farmed, and it never changes your watering schedule).
Row-unlock pacing removed: every week is now open from day one, so joining partway through the real course no longer locks you out of content your classmates already covered.
Visual-style switcher added: choose High-def, Low-poly, Text-based, or Cartoon chrome and palette, changeable any time in Settings.
Achievements retrofitted into the hub-wide framework: a static catalog, unlock toast, and hub dashboard link (unlock conditions unchanged).
Four arcade minigames added: Greetings & Basics Blitz, Verb Racer, Boutique Dash, and Café Rush — timed, scored alternatives to the calm farm loop, each gated to its own row range.
Report buttons extended to Review, Proficiency, and Bonus sections; typed-answer boxes now clear between questions.
Pronunciation-risk report button added for known mispronunciation traps.
Achievements added: two tiers tracking total plots automated and full weeks fully automated.
"Weeds" mix-up state, a personal error-pattern digest, a gender-tagging drill, and a liaison/elision practice quiz added.
Combo bonus, self-rated confidence, deliberate interleaving, adaptive distractor difficulty, a cultural notes toggle, and a progress dashboard added.
Slideshow cross-check merge: 9 new topics and 75 new items added from the teacher's own lecture slides.
Site-wide space theme visual pass.
Grading engine v2 (STRICT/LENIENT tiers), a "flag as correct" report button, a failure feedback blurb, a Review tab, weekly proficiency tests, and bonus sentence-building sections.
Core farm launched: the 23-week FREN151 to FREN152 syllabus catalog, spaced-repetition plant growth, a runtime question generator, and save-code support.
